newsitem.title: USA: Bullet Sports unit seeks Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Bullet Sports unit seeks Chapter 11.

text.p: Bullet Sports International Inc said Wednesday the board of directors of its Bullet-Cougar Golf Corp unit has approved a voluntary petition for reorganization of under Chapter 11 of the National Bankruptcy Act.

The company said in a statement the decision came after the company failed to obtain outside financing which was critical to the business' operations and that a filing is expected in the next couple of days.
Bullet-Cougar, the principal operating unit of Bullet Sports, makes and distributes golf equipment and accessories.
